ticks.note: Three transitions in one tick. `Idle` → `Work` sets `steps` to 1 and enters `Work` and `Begin`. `Begin`'s transition is immediate, so it fires at once: `steps` is 2 and `Done`, a final state, is reached. `Work` has terminated, and a `join to` without a trigger is immediate, so it fires too: `steps` is 3 and the chart is in `Finished`.
`Finished` has no transitions. Nothing happens any more.
